criteria.requirement: Add validate_all(instance, *, max_errors=100) to generated validator classes and the Validator protocol, raising public exceptions.ValidationErrorGroup for nonempty actual iter_errors results and returning None when valid. Preserve original ValidationError identities/paths and normal validate/is_valid semantics. A positive nonbool integer budget bounds stored errors and consumes at most one additional error to determine truncated; group exposes truncated/limit and derive preserves them for except*. Always close the underlying generator on completion/failure/cancellation. Keyword programming/resolution/schema errors must propagate instead of being misclassified as instance errors.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
